conteudo:
finally made my blogging page! yay!

i'm not dead set on this layout and i dont exactly know what i'll post about here yet. but its up and thats what matters! i can make it better later


today, i'll use it as a diary (kind of).

i went to the movies to watch Coyote vs. Acme and i'm so glad i did! i absolutely LOVED it. other than Obsession that was pretty much the only movie i really like this year (havent watched the spider-man one yet!)

that was sooo nostalgic, you might think looney tunes was too old for my generation, but i'm brazilian and those cartoons stood there for much longer. i grew up watching them!


not only that, this movie awakened the ''fandom spirit'' in me. i'll write more about it on my next post. for this one, let me just mention i'm genuinely obsessed with wilerunner edits... i learnt so much shipping facts about them and find them so cute... its such a weird couple to ship but TRUST ME if you give it a chance you'll be taken away too.


i know people here dont love social media — i swear im trying to get away from it — but search it on tiktok and fall in love.


also, that was FINALLY a movie with actual substance. they criticize corporations so directly, i missed this type of kids content so badly. everything has been so apolitical, this movie was a breath of fresh air.

its rare for this type of live action to be well executed, even rarer to have a good plot (cant even mention another example tbh) so this is definetely a must watch! will add it to my logs tomorrow :)

titulo: i miss 2021 culture so badly...
conteudo:
every now and then, this terrible nostalgia grows on me to the point of hurting. remember the pandemic? its so ironic that humanity was seemingly never as free as it was when we were locked in our homes.

everyone was out of the closet, now everyore is homophobic. everyone was alernative, now everyone hates ''weirdos''. everyone was so woke and now nazism is back. genuinely tho, what the fuck?


subcultures died, fandoms died. everyone needs to be normal and normal only. i feel like im stuck in the past everytime i think of an OC or edit a gay shipp. why is it so weird now? i grew up being even somewhat popular for behaving like that. suddenly everyone hates self expression so fucking deeply. i could write essays about it tbh, and all my theories of why exactly that happened, but whats even the point? no matter how much i observe the world around me, no matter how much i unerstand all the problems, i dont know how to fix any of them. its useless to ruminate on it if im not proposing a solution...


but you know what hurts me more? the way my used-to-be friends were caught up too. i hate the wordie normie, but they became such normies. i look at them with sadness. we used to be so proud of our individuality, now they're the type of person who would bully themselves from years ago.

and it was so fast. like, 2 or 3 years and they're GONE. why? and why am i immune? i dont wanna drink, smoke and get married. i dont wanna laugh at otakus as if i dont love anime. i dont wanna call alternatives weird as if im not one. i dont wanna say non binary doesnt exist as if i didnt identify with it. what happened to them?


i dont know if its just nostalgia but things were so much better. i miss people like me being the norm. its so hard to find them nowadays, its lowkey an online thing only. i guess before the pandemic that was the case, but i was too young for that. so i grew up in a time where we were everywhere, and suddenly, we're the weirdos on the internet. so weird.


i've been throwing myself into fandom spaces and trying to rebuild a social circle that behaves like me, but its damn hard. even twitter now just has people being racist or misogynistic. neocities is my only refugee, but its so hard to actually socialize around here...


anyways, im focused on stopping myself from getting away from myself. yeah kinlists are cringe, my OCs are generic and my art is ugly; who cares? i'll never stop being me. might as well go back to writing fanfics, why not? i need to feel true again. i dont wanna force myself to fit in anymore.


after all, i wonder how my old friends became who they are now, but i let myself go a lot. im just happy i realized that before it was too late, so i can still stop it. i miss them tho.


used to be one of the rotten ones and i liked you for that.
